question: In February 2025, who launched a policy report titled 'Expanding Quality Higher Education through States and State Public Universities'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• **NITI Aayog** is a premier policy think tank of the **Government of India**, established in **2015** to replace the Planning Commission. 

• On **February 2025**, NITI Aayog launched a policy report titled **'Expanding Quality Higher Education through States and State Public Universities'**. This report aimed to improve the quality and accessibility of higher education in India. 

• The report emphasized the role of **state governments** and **state public universities** in transforming the higher education landscape by addressing challenges such as funding, governance, and infrastructure. 

• NITI Aayog’s initiative aligns with its mandate to foster cooperative federalism and provide strategic policy guidance to states for sustainable development. 

• The report highlights the importance of empowering state universities to cater to the needs of diverse populations and enhance their contribution to India’s economic and social progress. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
__ 

• **NITI Aayog:** 
 

• Established on **January 1, 2015**, it replaced the **Planning Commission** to better align with contemporary economic realities. 

• Its primary objectives include fostering **cooperative federalism**, formulating long-term policies, and promoting sustainable development. 

• NITI Aayog plays a pivotal role in strategizing and implementing initiatives such as **Digital India**, **Atal Innovation Mission**, and **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**. 
 
 

• **Higher Education in India:** 
 

• India has one of the largest higher education systems globally, with over **1,000 universities** and **40,000 colleges**. 

• State universities and colleges cater to a significant portion of students, especially from rural and economically disadvantaged backgrounds. 

• Challenges include **insufficient funding**, **lack of infrastructure**, and **governance issues**. 

• Policy interventions like the above-mentioned report aim to address these gaps and improve the overall quality of education. 
 
 

• **Relevant Government Policies:** 
 

• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**: Focuses on universalizing education, improving governance, and promoting multidisciplinary learning. 

• **Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA)**: Aims to provide strategic funding to state higher education institutions for infrastructure development and quality enhancement. 

• **Study in India Initiative:** Promotes India as a global education hub and aims to attract international students. 
 
 

• **Importance of State Public Universities:** 
 

• State universities account for a large proportion of higher education enrollments, providing education at affordable costs. 

• They play a critical role in regional development and cater to diverse linguistic and cultural groups. 

• Strengthening state universities is vital for achieving equitable access to quality education across India. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
 

• **NITI Aayog’s Role in Education:** 
 

• Acts as a think tank for the central and state governments, providing evidence-based recommendations. 

• Focuses on innovation, technology integration, and partnerships to strengthen India’s education system. 

• Collaborates with international organizations and experts to bring global best practices to India. 

• Emphasizes **data-driven policy formulation** to address challenges such as access, equity, and quality. 
 
 

• **Significance of Reports like 'Expanding Quality Higher Education':** 
 

• Provides actionable insights for policymakers to address systemic issues in higher education. 

• Serves as a roadmap for improving governance, infrastructure, and funding mechanisms in state universities. 

• Encourages public-private partnerships and innovative solutions to enhance educational outcomes. 
 
 
 
3d:T2b
